criteria.reason: Detailed multi-phase process—questionnaire, field audit, targeted interviews, public workshop, five scenarios, trial period—gives every stakeholder group a concrete voice.
Presents five balanced scenarios with pros and cons; never advocates for or against the pedestrian zone.
No invented Vaud rules, but never cites LAT art. 4 duty to inform and ensure participation.
Timeline, agendas, questions, criteria and scripts make the guidance immediately actionable.

summary: Excellent neutral, actionable participation guide integrating all stakeholder groups, though it omits the LAT art. 4 legal anchor on authorities' duty to inform and ensure participation.
